scope: Only the AST-extracted DiT.unpatchify method; called with scalar settings via SimpleNamespace; no imports of author module or model instance/forward.
source_docstring:
x: (N, T, patch_size**2 * C)
imgs: (N, H, W, C)
teaching_patch_order: (patch row, patch column, within-patch row, within-patch column, channel); last three flatten as p,p,C
notes: Author code assumes a square patch grid h=w=int(sqrt(T)).
The 4x6 teaching example is a generalization using the explicitly known rectangular patch grid.
This validates output unpatchify order only. Input PatchEmbed comes from timm and its Conv2d weight flattening is not asserted here.
